data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘virgo’, meaning ‘maiden’ or ‘virgin’. In Christianity, the Virgin Mary is considered an embodiment of purity and devotion. The name Virgie carries the meaning “Virgin” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Virgie usually hope their child will grow to embody virgin and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Virgie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Virgin.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Virgie total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Virgie resonates with the rich cultural history of Christianity, especially in reference to the veneration of the Virgin Mary. This name beautifully encapsulates the sacred symbolism of the young, innocent, and pure woman, a profound value in Christian traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Virgie evokes images of the Virgin Mary, inspiring its bearers to uphold purity, innocence, and devotion in their personal lives. Moreover, it serves as a constant reminder of Mary's enduring strength and faith, inspiring followers to face life's trials with unwavering faith and unyielding determination.
